payload.answer: Runs untracked, issues file tracked, plumb hooks installed in the scratch repo (Recommended)

asked.key: where should the benchmark runs and the issues file live, and how should plumb be installed in the scratch repository? you said on 2026-10-21: "it writes into a file that we can later re-use to improve reliability of plumb"

options.description: Each run's folder is kept out of git. The accumulated issues file is committed. Plumb's hooks and skills are written into the scratch repository's own settings. Recommended: Keeping runs out of git while tracking the issues file keeps the repository small and keeps the file you asked to re-use.
options.label: Runs untracked, issues file tracked, plumb hooks installed in the scratch repo (Recommended)

options.description: Neither runs nor the issues file are committed; issues must be copied out by hand.
options.label: Everything kept untracked

options.description: Runs and issues are committed with the plumb repository.
options.label: Everything tracked in git
